title: UPSSSC Teacher Cadre JTC Eligibility Result 2026 – Out
intro: Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the Eligibility Result for the recruitment of Teacher Cadre JTC Assistant Teacher posts on the official website of UPSSSC. This recruitment has been issued for 58 posts. The online application process for UPSSSC Teacher Cadre JTC Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 06 April 2026, to 27 April 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for UPSSSC Teacher Cadre JTC Eligibility Result 2026 given below.
applicationFee: Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
